SQL Server ETL Data Engineer

Location: Nashville, TN
Employment type: Contract
Indicative rate: $58–$68/hr

Build and support SQL Server data solutions and ETL/ELT pipelines for relational and warehouse environments. Develop and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures, and implement dependable data movement and incremental processing. Work with business and technical partners to resolve data issues, validate source-to-target results, and shape data structures that support reporting and operational needs. Maintain clear, reliable, and well-documented data processes.

Core skills
Microsoft SQL Server
SQL
ETL/ELT
Data warehousing
Relational databases
Data modeling
Data quality
Required qualifications
Strong hands-on Microsoft SQL Server development experience.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries and stored procedures.
Experience designing, building, and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines.
Knowledge of relational databases and data warehousing.
Experience with incremental data processing.
Ability to troubleshoot data issues and reconcile source-to-target results.
Experience translating business concepts into scalable data structures or models.
Preferred qualifications
Experience defining data quality rules, reconciliations, or source-to-target mappings.
